title: 190. How to Become an OPTIMIST: 3 Positive Psychology Techniques to Change Your Mindset
description_html: In this week's solo episode, I talk about how you can completely shift your mindset to become more optimistic. I dive into why it's so helpful for your health and well-being to be optimistic before sharing three positive psychology techniques you can try out to unlock your inner optimist.

summary: sadie breaks down how to shift from pessimistic to optimistic thinking using positive psychology research. she explains the pyramid of positive emotions, positive affect, and optimism—and how each level impacts your health, relationships, and ability to cope. the episode centers on explanatory styles: how optimists view setbacks as temporary, specific, and external, while pessimists see them as permanent, pervasive, and personal. sadie shares concrete exercises like the best possible self intervention and explains how reframing the way you talk to yourself can genuinely change your mental health outcomes.
quote: people who believe that the causes of setbacks in their lives are temporary, changeable, and local do not become hopeless.
